## Design

### 2026-10-10 – ![Screenshot 2026-10-10 214710](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EMj7OOJJEoRobI2cOU9tmZbKMZE2QmsM/28a379e51ec6949048b0aef781160625afa6a03d0a5c8b708326b69cf230de96.png)

**5h**

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 214710](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EMj7OOJJEoRobI2cOU9tmZbKMZE2QmsM/28a379e51ec6949048b0aef781160625afa6a03d0a5c8b708326b69cf230de96.png)

Architected the core hardware platform for Starbie (Yeti J.A.R.V.I.S. Edition) around the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 microcontroller. Mapped peripheral assignments to prevent GPIO bus contention: shared fast I2C bus on GPIO6 (SDA) and GPIO7 (SCL) for both the 0.96" SSD1306 OLED and GY-521 MPU-6050 6-DoF IMU; 3-wire digital audio I2S bus on GPIO8 (SCK), GPIO9 (WS), and GPIO10 (SD) for the INMP441 MEMS microphone; and dedicated GPIO lines for the passive buzzer, DHT11 climate sensor, and dual tactile buttons. Built and wired the complete multi-sheet schematic in EasyEDA Pro, adding 0.1 µF 0805 SMD ceramic decoupling capacitors on the 3.3V bus and microphone VDD rail to filter high-frequency switching noise.

### 2026-10-11 – Designed, routed, and verified the custom carrier PCB for Starbie (Yeti J.A.R.V.I.S. Edition) from scratch to fit inside a 3D-printed Yeti companion figurine:

**6h**

Designed, routed, and verified the custom carrier PCB for Starbie (Yeti J.A.R.V.I.S. Edition) from scratch to fit inside a 3D-printed Yeti companion figurine:

Pin Mapping & Schematic Capture (Hours 1–2):

Mapped the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 GPIO pins to eliminate bus collisions. Configured a shared fast I2C bus (GPIO6/7) for the 0.96" SSD1306 OLED and GY-521 MPU-6050 IMU, a dedicated 3-wire digital I2S bus (GPIO8/9/10) for the INMP441 MEMS microphone, and dedicated I/O for the buzzer, DHT11, and buttons. Added 0.1 µF 0805 decoupling ceramic capacitors on the MCU 3.3V power bus and microphone VDD rail to filter high-frequency noise.

Enclosure Constraints & Placement (Hours 3–4):

Created a custom 48.0 mm × 45.0 mm board outline with 3.0 mm corner fillets to fit cleanly within the rounded interior cavity of the Yeti torso. Placed 4× M3 mounting holes at the corners tied directly to GND. Positioned the OLED display centered along the top edge for the figurine face cutout, centered the buzzer and buttons in the chest, and placed vertical sensor headers along the outer flanks away from MCU thermal dissipation.

2-Layer Routing & DRC Resolution (Hours 5–6):

Routed power rails with wide 0.50 mm (20 mil) low-impedance traces and digital signals with 0.254 mm (10 mil) traces. Poured solid top and bottom ground planes. Ran multiple Design Rule Checks (DRC) in EasyEDA Pro, resolving trace clearance violations and unconnected nets until achieving a clean 0 errors, 0 warnings pass. Exported RS-274X production Gerbers and drill archives.
